mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor expectations toward future monetary policy accommodation, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the likelihood of a near-term Federal Reserve rate cut, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both HOUST and RSAFS are below thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 over two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers a flight to safety in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 104.0 for two months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 297.0 over the past month signals accelerating inflation, which increases the probability of a Fed rate hike, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 297.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 153,000 over the past month indicates a weakening labor market, which increases the likelihood of a Fed rate cut and triggers a rally in equities, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is below 153000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad economic slowdown, which increases the probability of a Fed policy response, leading to a positive equity market reaction over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of cases when both RSAFS and GDPC1 are below thresholds, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 3.7%), indicates a weakening economy with deteriorating supply conditions, which increases the likelihood of a Fed rate cut and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.
